headline: Indian chip startup Bharat Semi raises seed funding for AI image sensors
body: Bharat Semi, an Indian semiconductor startup, has raised $24 million in seed funding to develop AI-enabled image sensors. The startup says it has secured design wins with General Atomics and Kaynes Semicon, while its image sensors remain under development, with commercial production targeted for 2027.
note: For investors, this is an early bet: the startup is pre-revenue, and its sensors are still in development.

evidence.text: Bharat Semi , an Indian semiconductor startup, has raised $24 million in seed funding to develop AI-enabled image sensors, as it seeks to win customers in the United States and elsewhere.
The investment comes as the nearly five-year-old, pre-revenue startup says it has secured design wins with U.S. defense technology company General Atomics and India’s Kaynes Semicon.
Its image sensors, however, remain under development, with the startup targeting its initial commercial production in 2027.
The all-equity seed round was led by Info Edge Group, South Park Commons, and Indus Bridge Ventures, with participation from Valour Capital, Micromax, Gaingels, and individual investors.
